issues.text: The activity gauge track (docs/shots/profile-scroll.png) is a pale cream arc that sits almost invisibly against the cream #FAF7F2 sheet; only the thin needle line and dot register at a glance. Give the track a value fill or a darker/more saturated arc color so 'Quiet week' reads as a gauge, not empty space, while keeping the warmth-never-guilt tone.

notes: Quick round 2: gauntlet profile --quick, 3 shots plus one extra --scroll 900 shot, 0 console/page errors, 0 failed requests, readyMs 1097-1293. Cream sheet radius 32, white rows, portrait renders at full size (round-1's 0-height portrait bug is gone), name 'Isabel', fact line 'Born July 1992 · Amsterdam · 12 memories', memories/people counts row, Top people list with 'View all people', activity gauge card, three question rows, and on scroll: Big capture buttons switch, Music opens in segmented control, Face ID toggle, the verbatim privacy string, Sign out, and a Viewing as persona picker with five avatars. glenn scene correctly swaps all data (44 memories, 13 people, different top people). people sub-screen lists all 9 people sorted by count with a back chevron. Only static quick scenes checked; the round-1 question-edit overflow and localStorage contract issue were not re-tested this round.
